_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.158 (The Soulless profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)
_book_notes: p.158: all Soulless use the standard profile, so the sergeant, major and epic rows repeat it and a squad is 5 x 20. p.178 pre-calculates the weapon team as 30 for 3 military figures; 3 x 20 is 60, and p.133 step 4 sums the profile costs, so 60 is used (the procedural page wins a self-contradiction, as with the 75-credit ship debt)

species.description: Synthetic beings operating as a networked collective. All Soulless share a single profile — there are no tiers or individual variation.

traits.name: Synthetic
traits.description: Soulless follow all the rules for Synthetic beings (see page 46).

traits.name: Machine Learning
traits.description: Soulless cannot be veterans in a pick-up game or when a campaign initially begins but may acquire veteran skills as normal for their unit type, as the network adapts to local circumstances.

traits.name: Hardened Network
traits.description: Soulless receive a 3+ Saving Throw against any attempt to hack into, interfere with, or jam Soulless communications and network connections. A successful save means that the specific source of intrusion is unsuccessful for the duration of the encounter. Repeated uses of the same method allows a Saving Throw each time they are used, until one is successful.
